en: Yes, and we're losing by a run. And did I mention it's already the ninth inning?
At this rate, they're going to pound us into the dirt! Please, could you go up to bat for us?
No thanks. You guys challenged them fair and square. If I just showed up out of nowhere, that wouldn't be right, now would it?
That's true, but... they brought in a hired gun, too. And he's a former pro.
They did? Okay, now that's just dirty.
That's why we thought it'd be okay for us to have a helper, too.
Well, it certainly would even the odds...
All we're asking is a little help. Even one at bat will do. We'll even pay you for your trouble.
Oh, all right. Just one at bat, then.
Sweet deal! Then let's get over there!
Boss, this is our last chance! You're the coach⑬you have to do something!
Oh, calm down. We're only losing by a run.
Are you kidding!? Our backs are against the wall here! It's the bottom of the ninth, and they've already got two outs against us.
Hmm. I kind of don't know what you're talking about, but is our situation really that dire?
You have to get your head in the game, boss! Your job is riding on this!
Daddy! I brought reinforcements! He's a really awesome batter who everyone's talking about online!
Oh, wow, that's great! We got a pinch hitter! Please, we need you on the plate at once!
Excuse me? How do you pinch to hit?
No, boss. It means to replace a batter with another batter.

What? You can do that in baseball? Let me get this straight.
It's like when you're at a massage parlor, and the girl is absolutely ghastly...
...Then you can change to another girl.
That's it! Yes! Spot on! Hahaha! You know your way around!
You have no idea...
(Why would he mention massage parlors in front of his own daughter...?)
All right then. Pinchy, have at it. Remember, a man's job is at stake here!
Oh, I just know you can do it! Please make my daddy's team win!

Your faith in me is well-placed. As surely as Shinada is my
name, so will I lead your team to victory.
So, here's what we've got. It's the bottom of the ninth, two outs, men on second and third, and we're down by a run.
In other words, it's the perfect setup for a game-winning, walk-off home run. I'll slam out a big one for this bad mamma jamma!
Hooray! Shinada-san, you were amazing out there! Thank you so much!
Oh, haha, no problem. No problem at all. I dedicated that hit to you, by the way.
You did? Well, you sure looked good in the batter's box. Almost like you belonged there.
(Ooh, this is definitely going somewhere. I can feel it! Oh please, <Italic>please</Italic> be my sugar mama! I'm more than willing to be your sugar baby.)
Thanks for that hit. You saved us all! Well, me, mostly.
I was just trying to help Yukina-san. She's a lovely lady.
She is indeed. I need to thank you somehow. Is there anything you request?
Oh, no! I wasn't expecting anything in return.
Now how about that? You're a man of rare nobility. But still, I must reward you. Tell me what you would like.
Well, if I may be so forward, I would like to ask for your blessing to... to know Yukina-san intimately.
I beg your pardon! Do you have any idea what you're saying!?
(Oh crap. Was I too hasty here?)
You slithery, scandalous scoundrel! How dare you try to get at my mistress! You should be ashamed!
Wait, she's your <Italic>what</Italic>!?
Oh, Daddy! Since you didn't get fired, you'll buy me a condo like you promised, won't you?
Hahaha! Oh, Yukina, you know I can't say no to my sweet little love duchess. Of course I will. Daddy always keeps his promises!
Okay, but it has to be a penthouse.
"Daddy," huh... Oh, right. That kind of daddy.
Uh... I suppose a thank-you is in order for helping us win.
Oh, yeah, don't mention it.
I know you got a bad impression of our boss, but he is a good guy to work for. I'm honestly relieved he won't be fired.
I know it isn't much, but please accept this as our thanks.
You got a <Color:8>Rage Ring<Color:Default>.
Gee, thanks. I guess I don't feel as bad now.
If there's another opportunity, we'd be honored to have you join us again. See you around!
Hey! Aren't you supposed to be some amazing batter? What have you done to us!? Daddy's gonna lose his job!
Now, now, Yukina. Don't be so harsh. I think he did what he could.
Do you even understand your situation!? You're getting fired from the bank! What am I supposed to do now?
Well, we could just carry on as before. Doesn't mean you have to stop being my mistress.
Huh? Your mistress!?
Are you crazy? What good is a sugar daddy without money? How do you intend to support my lifestyle!?
Ugh, you have got to be kidding! I'll reel in someone who's actually talented and stable. You can get bent!
Wait, my sweet little love duchess! *ahem* Yukina!
(Oh. So he was <Italic>that</Italic> kind of daddy. Guess it was too good to be true...)
Strike!
Hehehe, that's two outs. One more to go! That's the difference a former pro makes. You're smoking 'em, Esaka-san!
Hehe, what do you expect? It ain't shit shutting down these weaklings.
But damn. If you clowns would've scored more runs, I wouldn't even need to try. You're all a bunch of amateurs.
Ahaha, well, I apologize for that. We'll make sure to pay you good, though.
And I'll sweeten the deal with a little honey. There's this little babe who wants a piece of this⑬I'll slide her your way.
I like how you seal a deal. Heh, let's get her done.
Time! Time! We have a pinch hitter.
Huh? Who's this guy?
Now then... Remind me of our situation.
Bottom of the ninth, two outs, and no runners. We're losing one to nothing.
So a home run ties the game. Got it.
Hey, I'm askin' who you are over there!
Oh, just a batter who happened on by. Though I can't say I like the idea of a former pro waving his dick around in sandlot play.
Heh, sounds like a personal problem. Besides, what's wrong with getting paid and getting laid? That's about as good as it gets.
Yeah, yeah. Get off the mound already. This isn't about us. It's their game.
Get a load of this goody two-shoes! Hmph, all right. If you get a hit off me, I'll see myself out.
Though that'll never happen! Hahahahaha!
I'm gonna hold you to that, I hope you know. Now bring it!
Oh, I'll show you just how out of your league you are!
That's crazy... How could this happen? I used to be a pro!
Well, that's that. Now let them finish their game. Or are you the type to go back on their word?
Urgh... Fine...
Whoa! We're tied! And their hired gun is leaving the game, too. We have a chance at winning!
Yup. The meddler has been dealt with. Now it's a fair fight, so it's up to you to take this thing home.
You bet we will! Oh, but before you go, please accept this as thanks.
You got a <Color:8>Hunger Belt<Color:Default>.
Thank you very much! I feel like we're going to win this for sure!
All right, team! This is our moment! We're taking the diamond back once and for all!
(Sandlot ball's supposed to be a fun thing. Go for it, guys.)
Hahaha, you like that!? Swallow the taste of the big leagues, bitch!
Hell yeah! I knew we could count on you! We'll have the money and the honey all ready for you. Let's not waste any more time with these losers.
Sorry, guys... I just couldn't do it.
No, it's really not your fault. I think we already lost when we went looking for outside help.
It doesn't matter if the other team brings a hired gun. That doesn't excuse us from doing the same.
Hmm. Maybe you have a point there.
Even though we ultimately ended up losing, I think we learned a valuable lesson. Let's go back to training so we can win our field back.
Oh, and hey. We're sorry for getting you involved in this. At least take this for helping us.
(Those are some good guys right there. Wish I could've hit that homer for 'em.)
Took you long enough!
You again... The miracle pitch kid!
It's Kenta. You know why I'm here, don't you?
Another miracle pitch duel?
Yuh-huh. If you can get three hits off of ten of my pitches, you win. If you can't, the game's mine.
Hey, what the⑬!?
Huh? Where is it? My wallet!
Heheh... Gotcha!
You took my wallet, didn't you? Give it back, you little thief!
Sure, I'll give it back... if you can hit my best pitch! I know your batting's famous around here.
My batting has nothing to do with this, brat.
My name's not brat⑬it's Kenta! Now look, if you step into the box with me, you'll get your wallet back. Eventually.
Yeah right. I'm not gonna waste my talent on some twerp.
Fine. Then no stupid wallet for you.
Don't call my wallet stupid! Now give it here!
Waaaah! Somebody! Help!
What's going on!? Wait, you're that super awesome batter dude!
...Who were you again?
Kotetsu, man, the blogger! But who cares about that⑬why's this kid wailing all of a sudden?
Oh, well, you see... He kinda has my wallet.
I told you, I won't take off my clothes! Not in front of all these people!
Whoa! So <Italic>this</Italic> is why you come to the batting center!? To prey on innocent kids!?
Hey, time out here! It's not like that at all!
Waaaah! I don't want to, I don't want to!
You are one sick fuck, you know that? You stay put⑬I'm calling the cops!
Wait, wait, wait! This kid is... uh... He's my nephew!
Your nephew? Is that true? What was that about trying to take his clothes off, man?

Oh, that. Uh... That's because he refuses to change into his
athletic clothes. You always do this, right? Tell the man!
But Uncle! You never let me test my miracle pitch on you!
Fine, miracle pitch it is! I'll go up to bat right now! See, Uncle's not such a bad guy.
Yay! Uncle, you're the best!
Well how about that? You guys made me jump to a terrible conclusion. Guess <Italic>I'm</Italic> the sick fuck around here. Whoopsie-daisy!
Well? You get it now? I can be trouble if you don't take me seriously.
Trouble doesn't even begin to describe it...
Okay! You promised. We're gonna duel!
I'm warning you, you won't be able to hit my Super Bender Mark 6 that easily.
If you can get three hits out of ten pitches, you win. If you can't, then victory is mine!
Got it. But don't think I'll go easy on you just 'cause you're a kid.
Wouldn't want that in the first place. Now let's go!
No way! You hit my Super Bender Mark 6...
Yeah, I managed to somehow. I gotta say, kid, your curveball's the real deal. It really is a miracle pitch. I'm impressed.
But why'd you choose me of all people?
Kids my age aren't good enough for me. I thought maybe you would be a good challenge.

Oh, got it. Now look, I really don't care either way, but...
Try and show a little more respect to your elders. Okay?
Okay. Oh, and I prepared you a reward for hitting my miracle pitch.
You got a <Color:8>Sturdy Pole<Color:Default>.
Urk... *sniffle*
Huh? Hey, are you crying?
I'm just so mad my miracle pitch got hit! But I got plenty more where that came from! You'll see!
(Man, that was mega awkward... Kid had a wicked curveball, though.)
Aww, you lost to my miracle pitch again? Too bad, so sad!
Okay, gotta go! Buh-bye!
(Argh! My ego's taking a real beating here...)
No way. You hit my Super Bender Mark 6...
My teammates aren't good enough. No one my age is. So I thought maybe you'd be a good challenge.
That's understandable. But hey, I won our match. My wallet, please.
All right. Oh, you can have this, too. As a reward for hitting my miracle pitch.
I'm just so mad my miracle pitch got hit! But that's not all I got lined up. Just you wait⑬next time I'll strike you out for sure!
(Didn't mean to make the poor kid cry... Well, he shouldn't have nabbed my wallet.)
Too bad, "Uncle"! Even a top-tier batter like you can't beat my miracle pitch.
Damn it! That was a crazy curveball. How can a throw like that come from a kid like you?
Heheh, but wait, there's more. I have other miracle pitches, too. If you can hit my Super Bender Mark 6, maybe I'll show you.
Welp, gotta go for now! Buh-bye!
The miracle pitch kid, huh... Hey, wait a second. My wallet! He's still got it!
Hey, awesome batter dude. Your nephew left me your wallet. He said to give it to you.
What? Oh, he did? Thanks!
(The kid wasn't after my money, then? Weird...)
Heya! I was waiting for you!
Oh yeah, you're the miracle pitch kid!
Another miracle pitch duel? What was it again⑬Tomafork Mark 9?
If you can get three hits out of ten pitches, you win. If you can't, I win.
